rationale: CR-001 resolved: showDefaultRow is now computed once and used to gate both the synthetic default-row ternary and the regular-list filter guard, so the two conditions can never diverge again. The added regression test (default model with value: '') asserts it still renders exactly once; full unit suite (692 files, 6971 passed, 1 skipped) and the 4 touched LLMSelector test files (46/46) confirm no regressions. Fix-up diff is small (shared boolean + comment + one test) with no new security, public-API, or data-loss surface, so no confirmation pass was dispatched.

business_review.criterion: AC1 — default model displayed only once
business_review.justification: options useMemo filters models by defaultLlmModel.value whenever the synthetic default row renders (!allowEmpty, the path VirtualAssistantForm actually uses); LLMSelector.defaultDedup.test.tsx asserts exactly 1 row.

business_review.criterion: AC2 — default entry clearly marked as default
business_review.justification: Synthetic row label is '${defaultOptionLabelPrefix}: ${label}' ('Default: X'); covered by premiumLayout.test.tsx's new describe block.

business_review.criterion: AC3 — Premium label on default entry when premium
business_review.justification: defaultLlmModel.isPremium/isRouter now copied onto the synthetic row; premiumLayout.test.tsx asserts the meta line text is exactly 'Premium'.

business_review.criterion: AC4 — other models keep labels, shown once each
business_review.justification: Only the default model's value is filtered out of models.map; defaultDedup.test.tsx confirms the non-default model renders once with no meta line.

business_review.criterion: AC5 — search does not return duplicates
business_review.justification: One DOM row per model means PrimeReact's built-in label filter can only match once; defaultDedup.test.tsx's search test confirms exactly 1 match.

standards_review.notes: No HTML sinks, redirects, secrets, or cross-window messaging touched by the fix-up.

finding_status.notes: showDefaultRow shared boolean (LLMSelector.tsx:183) gates both the synthetic-row ternary and the filter guard identically; regression test added and passing.
